description: Audit chart colors for accessibility: pairwise OKLab ΔE separation under normal vision, deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia (published Machado 2009 matrices) and grayscale, plus WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 non-text contrast (≥3:1) against the background. Returns per-vision findings with human-word bands and a pass/fail verdict with reasons.

background.description: Background color the chart marks render on.

colors.description: Palette colors in slot order — any CSS color syntax (#hex, hsl(), rgb(), named).

mode.description: Floors preset. perceptual (default) fails what an eye can't tell apart (ΔE<2); redundant-encodings for palettes paired with dash/decal/shape channels; strict demands clear separation.

name: audit_palette
title: Audit a chart color palette
